title: Chinese vs European harness – the real difference
lines: Heard the Chinese standard allows eight hundred kilos of arrest force, and the European one point two tonnes? We checked.
In both standards, and the American one too, the energy absorber limits the force on the body to about six kilonewtons.
That is roughly six hundred kilos, no more, to protect your back and organs.
So the real difference is not the standard. It is counterfeits.
A harness with a genuine standard, Chinese or European, works. A fake one does not.
